responsibility: Implements the ISO date-and-time clock services on top of wrapclock CLOCK_REALTIME primitives. It probes whether the host clock can be read or set, validates calendar dates, converts between Unix-epoch seconds/nanoseconds and the module’s DateTime record using leap-year and month/day calculations, applies timezone and daylight-saving information from wrapclock, and drives SetTimeRealtime/GetTimeRealtime plus timespec allocation helpers to move between gm2 values and the underlying OS clock.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file differs from SysClock.def by implementing the system-clock operations: probing wrapclock support, validating calendar data, converting between epoch/timespec values and DateTime fields, and invoking the host realtime clock APIs.
